contributions.basis: schedule-total ('Total Contributions Received ... Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report' = 0)
contributions.detail: BLANK SCHEDULE, ZERO ROWS - a real zero, not a gap. Schedule A (p2) has no transaction lines at all. The 'Subtotal for this page $' cell is left BLANK (recorded "", never 0, per SS 3(f)) but 'Total Contributions Received $' carries a typed 0, and that is the anchor the zero row set is scored against: it is explicitly the sum of all Schedule A pages IN THIS REPORT, i.e. a per-report figure, so the rows are PERIOD-scoped. The rows do NOT equal Box C (Year-to-Date 2350.00), and Box B (This Period) is blank, so no cumulative anchor is available for them. Cache CFD prints no separate '$50.00 or less' aggregate line, so the le50 anchors do not exist (null, not zero). THE 2350.00 YEAR-TO-DATE FIGURE IS NOT ITEMIZED ANYWHERE IN THIS DOCUMENT - the itemisation for it lives in this filer's earlier 2022 filing (key 8d052c3e), which is transcribed separately in this chunk.

Box A (Balance at Beginning), Box B, Box D and Box F are ALL LEFT BLANK; only the printed 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period' 0.00 exists, with nothing to derive it from on the page. Two things are worth a human's eye and are reported, not repaired: (1) the closing balance is printed 0.00 although the only two figures on the Summary Page are Box C year-to-date contributions 2350.00 and Box E year-to-date expenditures 2479.01, i.e. cycle spending EXCEEDS cycle receipts by 129.01, which a strictly cash reading would make a negative balance; (2) both YTD figures are handwritten onto an otherwise typed form. Both figures retained verbatim; neither recomputed. Cross-filing chain against this filer's earlier 2022 document in this chunk (key 8d052c3e) is reported on that record.
